findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potentially unsafe ctypes usage
 * @description Using ctypes with untrusted input could lead to memory corruption
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-ctypes
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-119
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  exists(string moduleName |
    moduleName = ["ctypes", "_ctypes"] and
    call = API::moduleImport(moduleName).getMember([
      "c_buffer", "create_string_buffer", "create_unicode_buffer",
      "memset", "memmove", "memcpy", "byref", "pointer", "cast"
    ]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe ctypes operation that could lead to memory corruption if used with untrusted input."
findings.hypothesis: Insecure use of ctypes that could lead to memory corruption
